questions.cardText:
[Sociology] What is “anomie”?
A. The process of social aging
B. A lack of social regulation
C. An elite-driven social movement
Answer: B. Anomie can often lead to a breakdown of social bonds between individuals and the community, alienation, and moral confusion. The idea of anomie has been exemplified in films such as “Fight Club.” Some sociologists argue that the rise of digital technologies and social media may create new forms of anomie.
questions.de: Welcher von Émile Durkheim eingeführte soziologische Begriff beschreibt einen Mangel an sozialer Regulierung, der die Bindungen zwischen Individuum und Gemeinschaft auflösen kann?
questions.en: What sociological term, introduced by Émile Durkheim, describes a lack of social regulation that can break down the bonds between individuals and the community?

timeline.labelEn: Émile Durkheim introduces the concept of anomie in The Division of Labour in Society
timeline.labelDe: Émile Durkheim führt in „Über soziale Arbeitsteilung“ den Begriff der Anomie ein

questions.notes: Commonly glossed as 'normlessness'; Durkheim popularised it in Suicide (1897).

questions.cardText:
[Psychology] What is the theorized construct “g factor”?
A. Global cultural intelligence
B. Genetic influence on well-being
C. General cognitive intelligence
Answer: C. It refers to the “general intelligence” that is theorized to underlie performance on all cognitive tasks.
questions.de: Wofür steht das „g“ im psychometrischen g-Faktor, der der Leistung bei allen kognitiven Aufgaben zugrunde liegen soll?
questions.en: What does the "g" stand for in the psychometric g factor, theorized to underlie performance on all cognitive tasks?

timeline.labelEn: Charles Spearman publishes the paper in which he identifies the general factor of intelligence, g
timeline.labelDe: Charles Spearman veröffentlicht die Arbeit, in der er den Generalfaktor der Intelligenz, g, beschreibt
